query_text: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
Based on my search, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series was **first published on October 8, 2003**, created by writer Robert Kirkman and artist Tony Moore (published by Image Comics). The AMC television adaptation premiered **in October 2010**, nearly seven years later. The TV series was developed by Frank Darabont and was based on the comic book series, though it eventually diverged from the source material's storyline.
